sources.title: Adversarial Contrastive Learning for LLM Quantization Attacks
sources.snippet: Abstract Model quantization is critical for deploying large language models (LLMs) on resource-constrained hardware, yet recent work has revealed severe se-curity risks that benign LLMs in full precision may exhibit malicious behaviors after quantization.
